subject: refresh app using actionButton stopped working

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: refresh app using actionButton stopped working
parts:
I have an action button that (used to) reset an app to its original state. The code below is what I had. The setIniValues function is called and works but then the browser refresh doesn't happen. Any ideas?


actionButton('resetState', 'Reset')


observe({
  if(is.null(input$resetState) || input$resetState == 0) return()

  isolate({
    setInitValues()
    tags$script("window.location.reload();")
  })

})
